newsitem.title: USA: Hawkins intends to sell additional stock.
newsitem.headline: Hawkins intends to sell additional stock.

text.p: Hawkins Energy Corp said Wednesday it entered into a non-binding letter of intent with a private investment group to sell shares of the company's common stock and stock purchase warrants.

If consummated, the company would issue eight million shares of common stock and warrants to purchase an additional eight million shares at an exercise price of $0.91 per share, or a total consideration of $4.4 million.
Besides the cash, Hawkins said the transaction calls for a commitment by the purchaser to use reasonable efforts to provide business development opportunities to the company.
The warrants would have a four-year term but would become exercisable only if the purchaser satisfies the specified business development objectives.
It said the purchaser will be entitled to pick directors who would represent a majority of the seats on the company's board.
The letter of intent calls for the parties to reach a definitive agreement by October 11.

Consummation of the transaction is subject to certain conditions, including receipt of a fairness letter from an independent banking firm, approval by the Hawkins board of directors and satisfactory completion of the purchaser's due diligence review of the company.
In addition, Hawkins Energy shareholders will need to approve an increase in the authorized capital stock of the company in order to permit exercise of the warrants to be issued.
Hawkins also said it expects that shareholders will be asked to approve a change in the company's name.
